line.name: Enclave Connecticut
line.description: 4th Enclave wrapper variant (alongside Habano/'Enclave by AJ Fernandez', Broadleaf, and this one), released ~May 2021. Originally launched as an international-markets-only release (Germany, Austria, Poland, Switzerland, UK, South Africa, Slovakia, Hong Kong, Malta, Sweden per halfwheel); now also carried by some US retailers, suggesting wider distribution since launch. Not currently listed on the site at all.

research_notes: Mac photo library has only 1 photo for this line (a logo/banner, no vitola-specific shots) - consistent with it being real but less-documented/international-first. Strength not stated in any source found; left null rather than guessed.
